## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, tests, build)
- [ ] Tried in the browser at phone width (375 px) and desktop width
- [ ] Topics changed? Ran `npm run curriculum:index` (and `npm run curriculum:report` if lessons changed)
- [ ] Mentor prompts or providers changed? Ran `npm run mentor:check` with a real key, or said why not

## Safety and data

- [ ] No curriculum, lesson or topic ids renamed (saved progress is keyed by them)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or personal data in code, tests, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Content for children is accurate, kind and labelled honestly (aligned, curriculum-inspired or proposed)
